name: Stub load
description: STUB POST /STUB/load. Not an Unlimited URL. The set wrapper is the documented POST body element. Keys inside set are placeholders. records are read from return, which release notes describe for load only.

entity_type.description: Planned entity label. Sent as STUB_object. Not a confirmed Unlimited object name.

cursor.description: Lower bound from the per-entity watermark. Sent as STUB_after_id. The real request must filter to records newer than this value and return them ordered by cursor_field.

limit.description: Page size requested by the sync runtime.
